pick.name: Gemma 4 (E2B/E4B small; 12B, 26B-A4B and 31B larger)
pick.what: Google open-weight multimodal models: 128K context on E2B/E4B, 256K on medium sizes; audio input on E2B, E4B and 12B
pick.why: Best capability per RAM at 2-4B effective params; runs in llama.cpp/Ollama/LiteRT-LM/llama.rn
pick.maintained: Gemma 4 released 2026-04-02 per secondary sources; docs list E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B
pick.install: ollama pull gemma4  (= gemma4:e4b; also gemma4:e2b, :12b, :26b, :31b and -mlx variants)
pick.license: Apache-2.0 (Google's 'Gemma 4 license' link points to Apache 2.0)

alts.name: gpt-oss-20b (OpenAI, MoE)
alts.why: Strong reasoning, MoE keeps active params small; needs ~16GB RAM (unverified)
alts.free_limits: Also free on Groq (30 RPM, 1K RPD)

alts.name: Qwen3.x small models
alts.what: Qwen3.8 family supported by Unsloth; permissive small models

decision: Gemma 4 is the broad default (small E2B/E4B for any machine, larger variants for GPUs/Macs), with gpt-oss-20b for stronger reasoning and Qwen for multilingual/coding. Always benchmark on your own eval set; none match frontier APIs.
details: Speeds were not measured. Gemma 4 licence is reported as Apache-2.0 only in secondary sources (Google page does not name it).

os_notes.macOS: Apple silicon: E2B on 8GB; E4B or 12B on 16GB; 26B-A4B or 31B (19-20GB downloads) on 32GB+. Ollama ships -mlx tags; MLX LM is the alternative.
os_notes.Windows: NVIDIA GPU: 8GB VRAM fits E4B; 12GB fits 12B; 24GB fits 26B-A4B or 31B at Q4. CPU-only: E2B/E4B on 16GB RAM, expect a few tokens/sec.
os_notes.Linux: Same as Windows; NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm or Vulkan for GPU; CPU-only works with E2B/E4B.

verify.note: Google docs list E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, 31B; 12B was missing from the name. Ollama tags/sizes: e2b 4.6-7.5GB, e4b (latest) 6.6-9.5GB, 12b ~8GB, 26b 16-19GB, 31b 19-20GB. Old macOS note put E4B on 8GB (too tight) and Windows note put 20-30B on 16GB VRAM (26B download is 16-19GB). Release date still not on Google page.
